source: Independent name selection derived from Statistics Sweden Statistical Database API, newborn first names normally used in 2022
selection: First 1,000 names per explicit API sex (1 boys, 2 girls), descending published 2022 count then UTF-8 spelling. Include only published integer counts of at least two; exclude suppressed cells. Each spelling remains separate. Uses the first name normally used, not every given name.
display: Trim outer whitespace and normalize NFC; preserve published spelling, capitalization and diacritics.
nameFilter: At least two characters, starts with a Unicode letter, ends with a Unicode letter or mark; only letters, combining marks, spaces, apostrophes (straight or U+2019) and hyphens. Whitespace-trimmed NFC spellings are aggregated if identical.
licenseScope: SCB explicitly dedicates its Statistical Database open data to CC0 without source attribution. These exact API responses identify Statistics Sweden as their source; no other agency data is used. Ordinary SCB website tables are outside this admission.
attribution: Original input: the Statistics Sweden API table linked in this record. This library’s processed selection is not an SCB statistical product; no agency source label or endorsement is claimed for generated names. Provenance references are optional.
